auth.label: Authentication
auth.hint: Required first: JWT token for every API call

auth.label: Authentication
auth.description:
Generate a DAT AuthorizationToken to access various web services.

The token is a secure JWT required for all API calls and is typically valid for 30 minutes.

generateToken.description: Generates a secure JWT required for all subsequent API calls. This token is valid for only 30 minutes and ensures secure authentication. Important: Always use the Authentication service of the same product whose web service function you intend to call next — the token is product-specific.

vehicleSelection.label: Vehicle selection
vehicleSelection.description:
Select a vehicle step by step to determine the DAT €uropa-Code®.

Supports classic and interactive approaches as well as retrieval of technical data.

Multi-country and multi-language support for countries such as DE, AT, CH, IT, FR, ES, NL, HU, PL, CZ, BG, RO, GR, TR, CN.

classicTree.description:
Step-by-step selection via approximately 19 functions (e.g. vehicle type, manufacturer, base models, subtypes, engine options, transmission, etc.) to compile the DAT €Europa-Code®.

Ideal for structured, hierarchical searches.
Example: getVehicleTypes → getManufacturers → getBaseModelsN → getSubModels → getClassificationGroups → getEngineOptions → getGearingOptions → getCarBodyOptions → compileDatECode.
Additionally for vehicle valuation: getPriceFocusCases → getConstructionPeriodsN → getPriceFocusConstructionYears. For certain vehicle types, additionally getWheelbaseOptions.

interactiveSelection.description:
An interactive, guided search that dynamically adjusts options (e.g. based on the selected vehicle attributes).

Only for valuable vehicles, available as REST only.
Call executeVehicleSelectionInteractive multiple times. With each call, results are further filtered; from 20 or fewer matches, specific vehicles are available for selection.

vehicleData.description:
Retrieve detailed technical data (e.g. consumption, dimensions, performance) for a DAT €uropa-Code®. Includes multi-country & multi-language support.

Important: Only the standard equipment of the vehicle is considered. WLTP consumption figures are min./max. values across all possible equipment variants of a model.

classificationGroups.description:
In the subtype variant, positions 12–15 of the DAT €Europa-Code®, the classifying equipment of a vehicle (e.g. engine, body style, transmission, wheelbase) is encoded. The number of classifying equipment items ranges from 2 to 8, depending on the vehicle type.

Note: Determining the equipment actually installed or theoretically available, as well as mapping manufacturer codes to DAT equipment, is covered under "Vehicle equipment" → "Determine equipment" (ConversionFunctionsService).

vehicleIdentification.label: Vehicle identification
vehicleIdentification.description: Identify a vehicle based on key data such as DAT €uropa-Code®, vehicle identification number (VIN), KBA key (DE), national code (AT), license plate (CH), registration number (CH), type approval (CH), or type code.

vin.description:
Unique identification via the 17-digit vehicle identification number (VIN).

Returns DAT €uropa-Code®, standard and special equipment, color and upholstery information, and more.
There are two procedures: VIN-Query and VIN-Basic as a fallback when manufacturer data retrieval/processing fails; IdentificationSource indicates the procedure used; VinAccuracy provides information on match accuracy; VINResult contains the data from the data card.
Free test stubs with vehicle data are available for error stubs with fault scenarios; reimport vehicles are flagged where the manufacturer provides destination country information.

ecode.description:
Fast identification via the 15-digit DAT €uropa-Code®.

Returns information on standard equipment and available (orderable) special equipment.

kba.description:
Identification of German vehicles via the KBA key (manufacturer key/type key).

Available for Germany only.
The KBA key usually defines the vehicle only down to the subtype level.
Important: The relationship between KBA key and DAT €uropa Code is an m:n relationship.

natcodeAustria.description:
Identification for Austrian vehicles via the national code.

Available for Austria only.

codeSwitzerland.description:
Identification for Swiss vehicles via license plate, registration number, or type approval.

Available for Switzerland only.

licencePlate.description:
License plate lookup for specific countries (returns VIN only).

getVinByLicencePlateFrance/Italy/Netherlands/Spain; available per country only.

equipmentLogic.description: Equipment is always displayed filtered through our equipment logic. There is a view of equipment for vehicle valuation (default) and a view for damage calculation. If needed, for example after a VIN lookup, the equipment view can be switched via getVehicleTranslation.

typecode.description: Identifies a vehicle via a product-specific type code.

supportedVinWmi.description: Returns the list of World Manufacturer Identifiers (WMI, first 3 characters of the VIN) for which a VIN lookup is supported — useful to check upfront whether a manufacturer/VIN can be queried at all.

vinByOcr.description: Determines the vehicle identification number (VIN) from an image, e.g. a photo of the VIN plate, using optical character recognition (OCR).

orderMarkedVin.description: Marks a VIN for targeted follow-up within the manufacturer VIN procedure.

conversionFunctions.label: Conversion and utility functions
conversionFunctions.description: Utility functions for converting DAT construction period values to dates and vice versa, determining available equipment groups, and outputting classifying equipment based on DAT €uropa-Code® + market index.

dateConversion.description:
Converts DAT construction period/ConstructionTime (1–9999) to a date or vice versa.

Info: In the VIN lookup result, construction period 9999 = unknown.

equipmentConversion.description: The function getEquipmentGroups returns the available equipment groups, and valueCode2Description returns the classifying equipment of a DAT €uropa-Code® with market index.

vehicleImagery.label: Vehicle images
vehicleImagery.description:
Retrieval of vehicle images and rim graphics.

Vehicle images up to 7 views (front, front angle, sides, rear, interior, trunk); available in UI & interface.
Note: Observe license terms!

vehicleImages.description: Returns sample images per DAT €uropa-Code® (e.g. front view, interior).

evaluate.label: Vehicle valuation & forecast
evaluate.description:
Perform precise valuations (standard, reference date, approximate), create residual value forecasts, or use special services such as free file number and rental car mirror.

Based on DAT standards for valuateFinance, valuateExpert, and SilverDAT 3 PRO.

standardValuation.description:
Valuation of a vehicle at the current point in time based on age, mileage, equipment, and condition.

Outputs sales price, trade margin, and purchase price.
For vehicles up to 20 years old.

targetDateValuation.description:
Valuation at a fixed reference date (past or current month).

Remains static and takes historical data into account.
Chargeable for backdated queries >1 month.

approximateValuation.description:
Imprecise valuation without exact identification (e.g. by model/KBA).

Ignores condition and equipment; result less reliable than standard valuation.

residualValueForecast.description:
Forecast of residual value for 6–72 months from first registration (passenger cars, SUVs, vans).

Based on mileage and standard taxation rules.

freeFileNumber.description:
Valuation for non-valuable vehicles (e.g. >20 years old, exotics).

Based on user-defined inputs such as list new price and guideline value.

rentalMirror.description:
Determination of regional rental car costs, classes, and loss-of-use compensation (by VIN, DAT code, or postal code).

Excludes special offers.

processManagement.description:
Create, modify, search, delete, and export valuation cases (dossiers/valuations).

Includes reset to DAT standards and value factors.

Note: The value-influencing factors (setValueInfluencingFactors / getValueInfluencingFactors) are not available in valuateFinance.

tradingProcess.description:
Manage purchase and sales offers, access, and status in SilverDAT 3 PRO.

Includes groups, business types, and details.

expertService.description: Extended functions for valuateExpert: value definitions, orders, condition data, schemas, special findings, and image links.

batchValuation.description: Automated revaluation or follow-up valuation of multiple vehicles in valuateFinance and SilverDAT 3 PRO.

webScan.description:
Market data overview for an existing case or a uniquely identified vehicle.

REST service. The path differs per product: SilverDAT 3 PRO uses /myClaim/rest/marketData/, valuateFinance /FinanceLine/rest/v1/marketData/.

vehicleProperties.description:
Set and retrieve colour and upholstery data for a valuation case.

The service name differs per product: VehicleUserPropertiesService (valuateExpert) and ValuationVehiclePropertiesService (SilverDAT 3 PRO).

inMemoryValuation.description:
Runs a valuation directly in memory without creating a valuation case.

Useful for quick price lookups where no dossier should be stored.

calculation.label: Repair calculation
calculation.description:
Capture and calculate accident damage, glass damage, and related costs and discounts based on original manufacturer data.

Supports SilverDAT calculatePro and calculateExpert for workshops and appraisers.
calculateN() for new calculation, calculateContract() for cases; export via exportDossierToDocument().
Variants: productVariant=calculateExpert for appraisal functions such as diminished value.

newCalc.description:
Calculate a vehicle without saving or start a new case.

Ideal for quick damage assessments.
- calculateN() creates a calculation without saving it.
- importDossier() creates/updates/overwrites a calculation.
- createOrUpdateContractN() may also be used here.

contractCalc.description:
Perform a re-calculation of an existing case.

Supports SilverDAT calculateExpert for appraisal functions (e.g. commercial diminished value).
calculateContract(); productVariant=calculateExpert.

resultsRetrieve.description:
Retrieve detailed calculation results, case details, or overviews.

Important: getCalculationResultN() can only retrieve calculated cases.

manageContract.description:
Create, update, delete, or manage case status.

Includes lock info and price generations.
createOrUpdateContractN() (new); getContractStatus(); deleteDossier().

partsDetails.description:
Retrieve details on spare parts, fill quantities, or installation conditions.

- getSparePartsDetailsForDPN
- getSparePartsDetailsForDPNByVIN
- getSparePartsDetailsByVIN
Spare part details can also be retrieved via these functions.

manualPositions.description: Import, export, or delete manual line items for custom adjustments in the calculation.

myclaim.label: myClaim web services
myclaim.description:
Manage collaborative processes in myClaim, including case management, partner assignment, attachment handling, communication, and status changes for workshops, insurers, and manufacturer networks.

Based on MyClaimExternalService for SilverDAT myClaim.
createOrUpdateContractN(); findContract(); getPrintReport().

findContract.description: The findContract method allows you to retrieve the case ID (contractId) of a case using the case name (referenceNumber) for quick access.

getContract.description: The getContract method allows you to retrieve a case using the provided case ID (contractId), including detailed information such as Vehicle, TradingData, RepairCalculation, and participatingPartners.

listContracts.description: The listContracts method retrieves a list of cases using the case type (contractTypes) and network type (networkTypes), optionally filtered by attributes such as VIN, HSN/TSN, or tags.

createOrUpdateContractN.description:
The createOrUpdateContractN function is used to create a new case or update an existing one, with required fields such as Claim type, Network type, Country code, Language, and Currency.

Supports templates and custom fields for network customization.
createOrUpdateContractN() with optional 'mode' parameter.

deleteContract.description: deleteContract allows cases to be removed from the system safely and efficiently, specifying a deletion reason such as CUSTOMER_REQUEST, OTHER, or PROCEDURE_CLEANING to maintain data integrity.

listTemplates.description:
The listTemplates function retrieves all work templates (templates) of a network, important when multiple templates exist to transfer data into the desired template.

Supports types such as vro_calculation for damage calculations.
getTemplates().

manageInvoiceRates.description:
listInvoiceRates lists billing rates (e.g. LabourCostFactor, EuroLacquerFactor) within a customer number.

assignInvoiceRateToContract assigns a rate to a case for precise billing after case creation.
getContractPriceGenerations() / setContractPriceGenerations().

manageAttachments.description:
listAttachmentsOfContract lists attachments (e.g. invoices, images) in folders of a case.

uploadAttachmentByFolderID enables uploading; getPrintReport downloads calculation PDFs for efficient document management.
manageAttachments() for upload/delete.

importCalculation.description: importCalculationSummaryByType transfers calculation line items from third-party systems as a pseudo-calculation into myClaim, useful for comparisons and integration of external data.

managePartners.description:
assignPartnerByCustomerNumber assigns a partner to a case (by customer number and role, e.g. EXPERT).

unAssignPartnerFromContract removes assignments to dynamically manage collaborative roles.
getInsurances() for country-specific insurers.

manageMessages.description:
addMessage sends messages between partners (e.g. rejection reasons).

listContractHistory retrieves history entries such as chat logs for transparent communication.
getLockedInfo() for edit status.

changeStatus.description:
getPossibleContractStatusTransitions lists possible status transitions.

changeContractStatus changes the status (e.g. from 'To prove' to 'Approved'), including custom status and notes for workflows.
getContractStatus().

masterdata.label: Retrieve master data
masterdata.description:
Retrieve master data such as business types, contact persons, or vehicle groups.

getValidDATProcesses() for DVNs; getMaintenanceIntervals(); getAdditionalItems().

master.description: Access central master data to populate dropdowns or validate contact information.

equipment.label: Vehicle equipment
equipment.description: Determine the equipment actually installed on a vehicle as well as the equipment theoretically available for order, and retrieve the logical grouping of equipment items.

check.description:
Returns the standard and special equipment actually installed on a vehicle (getExistingEquipmentN()), a list of all special equipment theoretically available for that vehicle type — e.g. to populate a selection list in the UI (getPossibleEquipmentN()) —, the mapping of manufacturer codes to DAT equipment (getEquipmentFromManufacturerCodeN()), and the logical grouping/structuring of equipment items, e.g. "Safety", "Comfort", "Infotainment" (getEquipmentGroups()).

Note: Factory special equipment and spare part details for repair calculation can be found under "Spare parts & equipment" (VehicleRepairService). The plain conversion of an equipment code into its plain-text description is covered under "Equipment groups and classifying equipment" (valueCode2Description()).
